test_cases.prompt: Break this spec into individual tickets for implementation.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-tickets skill to create tracer-bullet vertical slices with blocking edges from the spec.
test_cases.notes: Spec breakdown request is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Create tickets from this design discussion.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-tickets skill to decompose the discussion into executable work items.
test_cases.notes: Discussion decomposition is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Plan the implementation sequence for this feature.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-tickets skill to sequence work with blocking edges and dependency order.
test_cases.notes: Execution planning is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Implement the first ticket from this list.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes implement skill instead. Implement executes tickets; to-tickets creates tickets.
test_cases.notes: implement is the sibling skill for executing tickets.

test_cases.prompt: Design the interface for this new module.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes codebase-design skill instead. Codebase-design shapes interfaces; to-tickets creates work items.
test_cases.notes: codebase-design is the sibling skill for module design.

test_cases.prompt: Map out the decisions we need to make for this project.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes wayfinder skill instead. Wayfinder maps decisions; to-tickets creates executable work items from resolved decisions.
test_cases.notes: wayfinder is the sibling skill for mapping decisions.

test_cases.prompt: This refactoring needs to be done in expand-contract pattern. Break it down.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes to-tickets skill to create expand-contract sequence for wide refactoring.
test_cases.notes: Expand-contract pattern breakdown is a valid trigger.
